content.servicesTitle:
Good work lives
in the details.
content.servicesDescription: From a single room to a full exterior refresh, we bring the same careful preparation and pride in the finish to every project.
content.transformationDescription: A tired finish can make a whole room feel dated. With the right preparation and a steady hand, familiar spaces can feel new again.
content.projectsTitle:
Made with care.
Made to feel like home.
content.processDescription: Clear communication and respectful work are part of a job well done. Here is what getting started looks like.
content.ctaTitle:
Ready for a change
you can feel?
content.servicesPageDescription: From a room that needs a reset to a kitchen ready for a new chapter, we bring experience, careful prep, and pride in the details.
content.areaDescription: A locally owned team in Danbury, serving homes throughout Fairfield County.
content.aboutDescription: Jeffe Painting is a local team built around a simple idea: treat every home with respect, and take pride in the work you leave behind.
content.aboutStoryAccent: A finish you can feel good about.
content.aboutStoryBody: With 25 years in the trade, Jefferson and his crew understand that a painting project is about more than color. It is about how a home feels when the work is finished—and how it is treated along the way.
content.aboutStorySecond: From the first conversation through the final walkthrough, the focus stays on thoughtful preparation, dependable scheduling, and clean, careful work.
content.valuesTitle:
The kind of care
we’d want at home.
content.projectsPageDescription: A look at painting, cabinet refinishing, and detail work for local homeowners.
content.projectsNote: Every home and project is different. Ask us what is possible for yours.

content.formDescription: Every detail helps us get a better sense of what you need.
content.contactNote: Not sure what you need? That’s okay. A quick call is a great place to start.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.reviewNotice: Policy template — business-specific review required before launch.
paragraphs: Information submitted through the inquiry form is stored on the business server for owner follow-up. Authorized owner devices can receive encrypted notification summaries via their push providers. The private dashboard requires login.

The site uses an HttpOnly owner-session cookie and temporary hashed rate-limit identifiers. The operating business must specify its identity, retention periods, providers, privacy contact and applicable rights before launch.
Do not submit sensitive personal information through the inquiry form.
